## About Our Regions
Our three regions create collaborative communities to help bring your ideas to life. Each region has a representative on the Executive Committee as listed below along with the colleges in each region:

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)

# Geometry is prebuilt by code/map.R and committed -- never regenerate it here.
counties_sf <- st_read("../data/nc_counties.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

county_dir <- read_csv(
  "../data/ccpro_counties.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    geoid = col_character(),
    county = col_character(),
    college = col_character(),
    region = col_character(),
    primary = col_logical()
  )
)

regions <- read_csv(
  "../data/ccpro_regions.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
)
```

```{r}
#| label: validate
# Fail the build loudly rather than shipping a map with gray holes in it.

missing_counties <- setdiff(counties_sf$geoid, county_dir$geoid)
if (length(missing_counties) > 0) {
  stop(
    "No directory entry for GEOID(s): ",
    paste(missing_counties, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

orphan_geoids <- setdiff(county_dir$geoid, counties_sf$geoid)
if (length(orphan_geoids) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Directory has GEOID(s) not present in NC geometry: ",
    paste(orphan_geoids, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

orphan_regions <- setdiff(county_dir$region, regions$region)
if (length(orphan_regions) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Region(s) in ccpro_counties.csv missing from ccpro_regions.csv: ",
    paste(orphan_regions, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Exactly one primary college per county drives the fill color.
primary_counts <- county_dir |>
  filter(primary) |>
  count(geoid) |>
  filter(n != 1)

if (nrow(primary_counts) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Each county needs exactly one row with primary = TRUE. Offenders: ",
    paste(primary_counts$geoid, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: assemble

# One row per county: the primary college sets the region and therefore the fill.
fill_assignment <- county_dir |>
  filter(primary) |>
  select(geoid, region)

# All colleges serving a county, collapsed for display. Handles the shared
# service areas without forcing them into a single-college model.
college_rollup <- county_dir |>
  arrange(geoid, desc(primary), college) |>
  group_by(geoid) |>
  summarise(
    colleges = paste(unique(college), collapse = "<br>"),
    colleges_txt = paste(unique(college), collapse = "; "),
    n_colleges = n_distinct(college),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

map_data <- counties_sf |>
  left_join(fill_assignment, by = "geoid") |>
  left_join(college_rollup, by = "geoid") |>
  left_join(regions, by = "region")

# Named vectors serialize to a JSON *object*, which leaflet cannot index
# per feature -- colorFactor hands back a plain unnamed character vector.
region_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = regions$color,
  levels = regions$region
)
```

```{r}
#| label: labels

# Hover: the quick answer.
hover_labels <- sprintf(
  "<div style='font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;'>
     <strong style='font-size:14px;'>%s County</strong><br>
     %s<br>
     <span style='color:#666;'>%s</span>
   </div>",
  htmlEscape(map_data$county),
  map_data$colleges, # already HTML (<br> separated), do not escape
  htmlEscape(map_data$region_label)
) |>
  lapply(HTML)

# Click: the full contact block.
director_line <- ifelse(
  is.na(map_data$director_name) | map_data$director_name == "",
  "<em>Region director TBD</em>",
  sprintf(
    "<strong>%s</strong><br>%s<br>%s%s",
    htmlEscape(map_data$director_name),
    htmlEscape(map_data$director_title),
    htmlEscape(map_data$director_institution),
    ifelse(
      is.na(map_data$director_email) | map_data$director_email == "",
      "",
      sprintf(
        "<br><a href='mailto:%s'>%s</a>",
        map_data$director_email,
        htmlEscape(map_data$director_email)
      )
    )
  )
)

click_popups <- sprintf(
  "<div style='font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;min-width:220px;'>
     <strong style='font-size:15px;'>%s County</strong><br>
     <span style='color:#666;'>%s</span>
     <hr style='margin:6px 0;'>
     <strong>%s</strong><br>%s
     <hr style='margin:6px 0;'>
     %s
   </div>",
  htmlEscape(map_data$county),
  htmlEscape(map_data$region_label),
  ifelse(map_data$n_colleges > 1, "Serving colleges", "Serving college"),
  map_data$colleges,
  director_line
)
```

```{r}
#| label: region-outlines

# Dissolve counties into region polygons for a heavier boundary stroke.
# Makes the regional structure readable without squinting at fill colors.
region_outlines <- map_data |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(.groups = "drop") |>
  st_make_valid()
```

```{r}
#| label: map
#| column: page

bb <- st_bbox(map_data)

leaflet(
  map_data,
  options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 6, maxZoom = 10)
) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.PositronNoLabels) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~ region_pal(region),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 0.6,
    opacity = 1,
    label = hover_labels,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto",
      sticky = TRUE,
      style = list(
        "box-shadow" = "0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)",
        "border-color" = "rgba(0,0,0,0.15)",
        "padding" = "8px 10px"
      )
    ),
    popup = click_popups,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2.5,
      color = "#222222",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    group = "Counties"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = region_outlines,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = "#2b2b2b",
    weight = 2.2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE), # never steals a hover
    group = "Region boundaries"
  ) |>
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$CartoDB.PositronOnlyLabels,
    options = providerTileOptions(pane = "shadowPane")
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = region_pal(regions$region),
    labels = regions$region_label,
    title = "CCPRO Region",
    opacity = 0.85
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Region boundaries"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  fitBounds(bb[["xmin"]], bb[["ymin"]], bb[["xmax"]], bb[["ymax"]])
```


:::{.callout-note}
  
Hover over a county for its serving college and region. Click on the county to view it's region director.
